reviews.title: This application is a ripoff
reviews.text: I have been using and PAYING for this application for a long time. I only use it to download and translate videos from one language to another. Suddenly, the application stopped letting me use it without a warning. I checked and everything on my end is working. I tried contacting the company and they have ignored my messages. I downloaded videos while I was paying for the application, now, I cannot open the videos that I paid the application for. I will be taking this company to court. How? I don’t know but I will start next week. We can not continue accepting the status quo. These companies ripping us off, and we, allowing them.

reviews.title: I Cannot Use The App
reviews.text:
I paid for a lifetime subscription, but I haven't been able to use the app for the past four weeks. I tried reaching out to support multiple times, but no one responded. I am very furious because I use the app regularly. I paid full price for the subscription. I need someone to explain what is going on with the subscription I bought.


I appreciate that you are looking into the app to identify the issue. I still have not received a response from you guys. It's very frustrating when I copy a link from TikTok or Instagram. The app is telling me (unauthentic! Please ensure that you’re running the application downloaded from the App Store and try again). I’ve checked everything. I even logged out and back in to the app, and it’s still not working. Guys, come on now. I need this app to work because I already paid for it. Thank you. I await your response.

reviews.text:
I figured I would try this app to save some videos from X. It offered a free 3 day trial for $9.99 but of course you had to add a payment method so they could charge you if you decided to keep the app. I figured I would try it the first day and see how it worked and decide if I would keep it. I used my Apple Pay as a payment method the clicked on 3Day Free Trial. It immediately charged me not after 3 days as it was stated. I closed and deleted the app because I was so upset. 

PLEASE CONTACT ME FOR MY REFUND‼️

reviews.title: So many fake reviews!!
reviews.text: I mistakenly gave this a shot because of all the positive reviews. Instead (feel free to dl yourself to confirm): it immediately pivots from “saving” media to “reposting” it, you’re prompted to rate it five seconds after launching it the first time, and only after several pages of sales pitch do you realize it’s a subscription service (a 3-day trial that becomes $9.99/WEEK?!!) Dayum… the scammers have gotten greedier and bolder.
